steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to a buy auction using the available auction configuration.
Provide the mandatory event title required before publishing.
Select a reverse buy auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the requested product as the first line item with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet before configuring and publishing the event.

args.goal: On the auction create screen, set the first line item's Plant Name or delivery location to LOC-0001, set the auction floor price to -10, and leave the screen showing the validation that the floor price cannot be negative.

steps.note: No catalog step exposes the auction floor-price field or the exact location control; this performs those buyer-side screen actions and observes the negative-floor validation.
Invite two QA test vendors as required by the scenario.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Attempt to publish after the invalid negative floor price is configured, as required by the case.
Assert that publishing is refused with the specified validation message.
